auth_method.label: Sign in
auth_method.description: Sign in with the Bilibili app to access your favorite folders and higher audio quality, or continue without an account (public content only).

options.qr: Scan a QR code with the Bilibili app

audio_quality.label: Preferred audio quality
audio_quality.description: Lossless (Hi-Res FLAC) needs a premium (大会员) account and is only available for some uploads; otherwise the best AAC stream is used.

music_zone_only.label: Search the music zone only
music_zone_only.description: Restrict video search to Bilibili's music zone for more relevant results.

clean_titles.label: Clean up video titles
clean_titles.description: Strip decorations like 【Hi-Res无损】 from video titles and use the song name between 《》 when present.

user.title: Connect Bilibili
user.description: Choose how to connect. Signing in shows a QR code in the next step.

scan_qr.title: Scan to sign in
scan_qr.description: Scan the QR code with the Bilibili app and confirm the login. A fresh code is shown automatically if it expires.
scan_qr.progress_text: Waiting for you to scan and confirm in the app...

manifest.description: Stream the audio of Bilibili videos: search, uploaders, favorite folders and music charts.
